title: On Local Finiteness of Modal K4 Algebras
summary: We study local finiteness for modal $K4$ algebras via the tunability of their dual general frames. In particular, we provide a sufficient condition for modal $K4$ algebras to be locally finite by identifying a structure which must be present in non-locally finite modal $K4$ algebras. We then show that this condition becomes both necessary and sufficient for complex modal $K4$ algebras. Next, we translate this condition into a pair of order-theoretic conditions on transitive Kripke frames, providing a classification of local finiteness on their dual modal algebras.
